Favorites album behavior vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Photos heart-star toggles on device cover storefront language. PhotoKit favorite flags, Favorites album routing, and Connect actually separate in-app Favorites behavior from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Favorites — the system album where buyer-starred photos and videos collect on device. Controls on-device curation — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Heart or star to favorite — the tap action buyers use to add a photo or video to Favorites. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building favorite-toggle UI is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Starred photos & hearted photos — user-curated stills and clips the buyer manually saved to Favorites, distinct from every shot in Recents. Listing copy names that path; building favorites-grid UI is engineering.
  • Add to Favorites & remove from Favorites — toggle and un-favorite actions on gallery frames. zh-Hans overlays should name those actions when your English frames show heart or star controls — not English-only "Add to Favorites" pasted through machine translation.
  • Browse your favorites collection — buyers open the Favorites album to review starred items instead of scrolling the chronological Recents library or the Media Types format grid. Listing copy names that path; building album UI is engineering.
  • Recents library (different surface) — chronological camera-roll All Photos grid under Photos → Recents. Related buyer vocabulary (最近项目) but not the same product story — do not paste Recents copy onto Favorites hero frames. See Recents listing (zh-Hans, contrast).
  • Media Types hub (different surface) — format-album grid under Albums → Media Types listing Videos, Selfies, Screenshots, and related smart albums — not the user-curated Favorites collection. Mention only as contrast. See Media Types listing (zh-Hans, contrast).
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Favorites support in the binary.

Working Favorites album integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Favorites, 个人收藏, and 收藏 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you wire favorite-flag APIs in code.

  • Calling Favorites "Media Types" — 媒体类型 fits the format-album hub grid; Favorites is a user-curated starred collection — see Media Types listing (zh-Hans, contrast)

Favorites-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Favorites and starred-collection listings use vocabulary general photo-library guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple's Favorites album — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Favorites & 个人收藏

US pages use "Favorites" on the album grid under Photos → Albums. Apple's Simplified Chinese Photos vocabulary often uses 个人收藏 for the Favorites album hero, with 收藏 on shorter badges and heart-star action labels. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing curation capabilities your app does not support.

Starred photos & hearted photos

English listings use "starred photos", "hearted photos", or "favorite shots" on grid and detail frames. zh-Hans copy should describe those items with 收藏的项目 or 收藏的照片 when that matches your English source — distinct from every photo in Recents or algorithmic picks in Featured Photos.

收藏夹

Some English listings use "favorites collection" or "your favorites folder" phrasing. Chinese buyers may search 收藏夹 for collection-style favorites marketing — related to 个人收藏 but useful as keyword overlap when your English gallery uses folder or collection wording.

Add to Favorites & remove from Favorites

Action-oriented screenshots — tap the heart or star to favorite, swipe to unfavorite — need verb phrases Chinese readers recognize. Frames should pair 添加到个人收藏 or 取消收藏 with the UI your gallery actually shows — heart icon, star badge, or Favorites toggle on photo detail.

Find favorited shots vs browse Recents

Many Favorites marketing screenshots compare the starred album with the main library timeline. zh-Hans copy should explain why buyers open Favorites instead of Recents when your English gallery shows that contrast — without making Recents the primary hero unless your frames center the chronological library.

Do not conflate with Featured Photos or Memories

Favorites is a manually curated starred album. Featured Photos surfaces algorithmic For You highlights — different buyer promise. Memories builds recap movies — not favorites browsing. If your app supports multiple surfaces, scope each screenshot frame accurately.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Favorites-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 个人收藏, 收藏, and 收藏夹 each signal different intent from Recents 最近项目 keywords or Media Types 媒体类型 keywords.

  • Assuming heart-star toggles localizes automatically — Favorites album UX shipped; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and Favorites screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating Favorites with Recents — 最近项目 fits chronological library browsing; 个人收藏 fits Favorites album frames with heart toggles
  • Conflating Favorites with Media Types — 媒体类型 fits the format-album hub; Favorites is user-curated starred items
  • Conflating Favorites with Featured Photos — 精选照片 fits For You highlights; Favorites is manually hearted content
  • Conflating Favorites with Selfies — 自拍相簿 fits front-camera album grids; Favorites collects starred items from any source
  • English Favorites badges on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in badges on PNG exports are still Latin
  • Expecting AppLocale to implement favorite-flag APIs — PhotoKit favorites engineering is outside listing rewrite

FAQ

Does tapping the heart to favorite a photo auto-fill my China App Store listing?

No. Favorites album organization and heart-star toggle flows control runtime library behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. If zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, or screenshot caption fields are empty or still English, the China storefront falls back to en-US copy.

Which App Store Connect fields does AppLocale rewrite?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese for listing fields you specify: app name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as Favorites, starred photos, hearted photos, add to Favorites, 个人收藏, 收藏, 收藏的项目, and 收藏夹 — rewritten from your English originals.

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. PhotoKit favorite flags, Favorites album queries, and heart-star UI engineering are outside AppLocale scope.

Each appears in Chinese storefront and search contexts. AppLocale picks phrasing that matches your English listing claims and screenshot overlays — 个人收藏 for the Favorites album hero, 收藏的项目 for starred-item grid frames, 收藏夹 for collection-style marketing — without inventing capabilities your app does not support.
